plugin.name: medo
settings.glyph.label: Glyph
settings.glyph.description: Icon shown on the bar beside today's count.
settings.show_count.label: Show the count
settings.show_count.description: Show done/total in the bar. Turning both bar parts off still shows the count.
settings.show_mascot_dot.label: Show the Medo dot
settings.show_mascot_dot.description: Show the coloured glyph in the bar beside the count.
settings.rollover_hour.label: Day rollover hour
settings.rollover_hour.description: Hour (0-23) when today ends. 4 keeps late-night work on the previous day.
settings.default_estimate.label: Default estimate
settings.default_estimate.description: Minutes a task is worth when it has no estimate of its own.
settings.streak_threshold.label: Streak threshold
settings.streak_threshold.description: Daily score (0-100) needed for a day to extend the streak.
settings.trash_days.label: Trash retention
settings.trash_days.description: Days a deleted task stays restorable before rollover purges it.
settings.export_dir.label: Report export folder
settings.export_dir.description: Where exported Markdown and JSON reports land. Empty uses your Documents folder.
settings.sounds_enabled.label: Sound cues
settings.sounds_enabled.description: A chime when a task completes, a jingle when the whole list is done, a thud on delete.
settings.mascot_enabled.label: Mascot artwork
settings.mascot_enabled.description: Show the Medo blob in the panel header and dashboard instead of the text face.
settings.notify_morning.label: Morning digest
settings.notify_morning.description: A toast at the morning time with today's plan and carry-overs.
settings.notify_evening.label: Evening triage nudge
settings.notify_evening.description: A toast at the evening time when tasks are still open.
settings.notify_due.label: Due alerts
settings.notify_due.description: Toast when a task reaches its due time.
settings.notify_lead.label: Lead reminders
settings.notify_lead.description: Toast shortly before a task is due.
settings.notify_weekly.label: Weekly report toast
settings.notify_weekly.description: Toast when the weekly report is ready.
settings.notify_monthly.label: Monthly report toast
settings.notify_monthly.description: Toast when the monthly report is ready.
settings.notify_atrisk.label: At-risk nudge
settings.notify_atrisk.description: One afternoon toast when the day has barely moved.
settings.morning_time.label: Morning time
settings.evening_time.label: Evening time
settings.atrisk_time.label: At-risk time
settings.weekly_day.label: Weekly report day
settings.weekly_day.description: Day the weekly report toast fires.
settings.weekly_time.label: Weekly report time
settings.monthly_time.label: Monthly report time
settings.monthly_time.description: HH:MM on the 1st for the monthly report.
settings.week_start.label: Week starts on
settings.week_start.description: First day of the week in the Reports range, its day order and the weekly report toast. Monthly ranges stay calendar months. Pair it with the weekly report day so the toast reviews a finished week.
settings.quiet_start.label: Quiet hours start
settings.quiet_start.description: Reminders are suppressed from this time; due alerts still fire.
settings.quiet_end.label: Quiet hours end
settings.lead_min.label: Default lead time
settings.lead_min.description: Minutes before a due task to remind when the task has no lead of its own.
settings.cap_enabled.label: Daily soft cap
settings.cap_enabled.description: Warn when today's list grows past the cap.
settings.daily_cap.label: Cap
settings.daily_cap.description: How many tasks today holds before adding one asks first.
panel.tagline.empty: nothing planned. medo is suspiciously calm.
panel.tagline.start: one at a time. three is plenty.
panel.mascot.sleepy: slow start. one small thing counts.
panel.mascot.focused: in the middle of it. keep going.
panel.mascot.proud: look at that number. proud of you.
panel.mascot.celebrating: 100%. medo is doing a little dance.
panel.reports_empty: Reports need a few closed days. Come back Sunday.
panel.reports_empty_sub: The live day starts counting once it closes.
panel.field.title: Title
panel.cap_prompt: Today already has {count}. Add one more anyway?
panel.empty.today: Nothing planned yet. Three is a good number to start.
panel.empty.pending: No leftovers. Medo is pleasantly surprised.
panel.reports_note: reports are built on demand from closed days + today
panel.footer.hint: type to add · Enter saves · click a row to edit
panel.overdue.one: {count} task is late. Not judging. (a little.)
panel.overdue.other: {count} tasks are late. Not judging. (a little.)
panel.triage.title: evening triage
panel.triage.empty: Nothing left to decide. Good night.
panel.triage.hint: Retry keeps it, Park sends it to Pending, Drop moves it to Trash. Rollover carries whatever is left.
panel.empty.trash: Nothing thrown away. Look at you.
panel.empty.trash_sub: Deleted tasks wait here, restorable, until they age out.
panel.trash.footer: Trash empties itself after {days} days. Restore anything you still want.
celebration.headline: Nothing left on the list. Go touch grass.
celebration.line: {done}/{total}. Medo is doing a little dance.
triage.copy.open: {count} left today. Retry, park or drop?
triage.copy.pending: Nothing left today. Pending can wait for tomorrow.
triage.copy.done: Nothing left today. Medo is impressed.
notify.morning: Morning. {planned} planned, {carried} carried. Medo is ready.
notify.morning.empty: Morning. Nothing planned yet. Three is a good start.
notify.atrisk: Half the day gone, nothing moved. Still fine.
insight.carryover.one: You carried {carried} of {assigned} tasks. Your plan was ~{count} task too ambitious — cap it at {cap}.
insight.carryover.other: You carried {carried} of {assigned} tasks. Your plan was ~{count} tasks too ambitious — cap it at {cap}.
insight.streak.one: {weekday} broke a {run}-day streak at {count} task left.
insight.streak.other: {weekday} broke a {run}-day streak at {count} tasks left.
insight.due: Tasks with a due time finish {lift}% more often. Give the big ones a time.
insight.avg_progress: You stop at ~{progress}% a lot — those tasks are too big. Split anything over 45 min.
insight.weekday: {weekday}s are your power day. Schedule the scary task there.
insight.steady.week: A steady week. Nothing to improve — suspiciously good.
insight.steady.monthly: A steady month. Nothing to improve — suspiciously good.
launcher.hint.title: medo buy milk @17:00 #errand !high
launcher.hint.subtitle: type a task — the tokens become the due, tag and priority
launcher.untitled.title: Give it a title
launcher.untitled.subtitle: tokens alone do not make a task
error.corrupt_doc: tasks.json is unreadable and no backup recovered it; starting a fresh list
error.recovered: tasks.json was unreadable; recovered the previous copy
error.export_build: export: could not build the report
error.export_encode: export: could not encode the report
error.import_json: that file is not valid JSON
error.import_shape: that file is not a medo document
error.import_schema: that file uses a schema this medo does not know
error.import_day: that file has no valid day
error.import_tasks: that file's task list is not a list of tasks
error.import_trash: that file's trash list is not a list of trashed tasks
